why: The clause that makes the arm worth having. `marks` draws this slot's outline once per stock, so a leading copy states the identity a second time -- and lands next to a hollow LOST mark of the same shape. For slot 1 those are the same circle drawn the same way, so an entry that has lost a stock appears to carry two identity marks instead of one and a spent stock. Measured on a real frame with both flags on, before this guard existed; it is the defect that prompted the arm.
killedBy: hud: identity-shaped stocks, the `marks` arm (issue #230) suppresses the leading marker, which is the whole point of the arm
